summary: run_scheduled_op no longer charges durable #634 spend on dry_run previews; when base_dir is set, budget hydrate/charge uses base_dir/budget and ledger writes use base_dir/ledger so dry-run loops cannot exhaust operator spend.json (#634/#641).
migration_impact: Local only. dry_run scheduled ops skip budget_charge; live apply still charges. Callers with base_dir get isolated budget+ledger like fleet handoffs.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / pull release with this fix.
2. Prefer dry_run=true for previews; only dry_run=false applies spend.
3. If spend was already polluted, gh plate autonomy --budget-reset.
agent_notes: dry_run must never call apply_live_budget_charge. Mirror this rule for any new gated surface. Pairs with fleet base_dir isolation and budget-reset.
